notes: Safety batches (docs/adr/0038 V, views in safety batches): one static view per twin, at a seeded random viewpoint each take. No moving views: the real cameras are mounted, and a counterfactual replay keeps its source's change, so it gets exactly its source's views. The same target, rules and records as recon.json. Training split: never a viewing direction in heldOut (azimuth 60-120 deg, the robot's left side, at every elevation), which safety-holdout.json keeps for test sessions.
